why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Jacob Gonzalez is slot #6 (4.330 expected team runs/game).
Slots #6, #7, #2, #5, #8, #1, #3, #4, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #8 ranks 5 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.002 R/G.
Slot #6 yields 4.11 expected PA/game vs 3.89 at primary slot #8. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
Offensive profile group: Spray Contact (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models -0.001 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
